description: This file implements the Telemetry plugin for WPEFramework, including methods for report management, privacy mode notifications, and system event handling. It registers RPC methods and interacts with system services, IARM bus, and RBUS.

classes.name: Telemetry
classes.description: Main plugin class that manages telemetry reports, privacy modes, and system events.

methods.name: setReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the report profile status, mainly 'STARTED' or 'COMPLETE'.

methods.name: logApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with a specific name and value.

methods.name: uploadReport
methods.description: Initiates the report upload via RBUS.

methods.name: abortReport
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing report upload via RBUS.

methods.name: notifyT2PrivacyMode
methods.description: Notifies RBUS of privacy mode changes.
